roadmap.title: Easy story and collectible run
roadmap.description: Complete all six episodes on Easy while following a collectible route. Use both diner jukeboxes in the same run, handle chapter-specific objectives, and spend every weapon type freely to build cumulative counters.

roadmap.title: Chapter-select cleanup
roadmap.description: Replay chapters on Easy for any missed boss, timer, no-death, no-gun, combat, or collectible objective. Cumulative statistics and collected objects persist after checkpoint restarts and chapter cleanup.

roadmap.title: Nightmare playthrough
roadmap.description: After the first completion unlocks Nightmare, finish all six episodes on Nightmare and collect the 15 difficulty-exclusive manuscript pages. The completion also awards the Normal and Hard difficulty achievements.

roadmap.title: Complete The Signal
roadmap.description: Run The Signal on Normal, collect its ten alarm clocks and six standees, avoid every vehicle, trigger all furnaces, and finish without a checkpoint reload. Retry the final television battle separately if its timer is missed.

roadmap.title: Complete The Writer
roadmap.description: Run The Writer on Normal, collect all ten video games, take the secret cave detour, complete both timed or restricted sections, hear Hartman's entire recording sequence, and protect the uninterrupted run and final-fight health conditions.

achievements.description: Take a night course of light education.
achievements.summary: Complete the opening nightmare tutorial and reach the @loc{lighthouse}.

guide.context: This automatic Episode One milestone teaches light-based combat and cannot be blocked by difficulty or optional actions.

steps.text: Follow the tutorial route, defeat the shadow enemies as instructed, and enter the @loc{lighthouse} to finish the nightmare sequence.

achievements.description: Take a walk through the logging area, meet one of the quirky locals.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Stucky} in the Episode One logging area.

guide.context: Stucky is the first mandatory named Taken encounter, so the achievement cannot be missed during story progress.

steps.text: Hold the flashlight beam on @enemy{Stucky} until his darkness shield disappears.
Shoot the unshielded @enemy{Stucky} until the mandatory logging-area battle ends.

achievements.description: Call for help.
achievements.summary: Reach the Episode One @loc{gas station} and use its telephone to call for help.

guide.context: The telephone call ends Episode One and is required to advance the story.

steps.text: Continue through the logging area until Alan enters the @loc{gas station}.
Use the telephone inside the gas station and complete the call to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: See what's on TV.
achievements.summary: Near the end of Episode Four, turn on the advertising television at @loc{Cauldron Lake Lodge} before escaping the darkness.

guide.context: This advertising set is separate from the 14 programs counted by Couch Potato, so the other television checklist does not cover this unlock.

steps.text: During the late Episode Four escape from @loc{Cauldron Lake Lodge}, stop at the television beside the required route.
Turn on the television before continuing through the escape sequence; the achievement registers from that set.

achievements.displayName: Under a Thin Layer of Skin
achievements.description: Defy the park ranger.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Rusty} during the mandatory Episode Two fight at @loc{Elderwood National Park}.

guide.context: Rusty's darkness protection must be removed before gunfire can damage him, following the same rule used for ordinary Taken.

steps.text: Keep the flashlight focused on @enemy{Rusty} until his darkness shield burns away.
Fire at the unshielded @enemy{Rusty} until the Episode Two boss encounter ends.

achievements.description: Enjoy the sounds and sights of Elderwood National Park.
achievements.summary: Complete the mandatory @loc{Elderwood National Park} section of Episode Two.

guide.context: This is an automatic story milestone; collectibles and optional detours do not affect it.

steps.text: Follow the Episode Two objectives through @loc{Elderwood National Park} until Alan leaves the park section and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Survive the bulldozer attack.
achievements.summary: In Episode Three, destroy the possessed @enemy{bulldozer} instead of escaping past it.

guide.context: The route permits Alan to flee, which skips the unlock. The vehicle takes damage from sustained light, and flare-gun shots can shorten the fight.

steps.text: When the possessed @enemy{bulldozer} attacks in Episode Three, remain in the arena rather than running to the next objective.
Keep the flashlight trained on the bulldozer, using flare-gun shots if available, until the vehicle is completely destroyed.

achievements.description: Encounter a steam engine.
achievements.summary: In Episode Three's @loc{Ghost Town}, destroy both possessed @enemy{steam-engine components}.

guide.context: Running through the Ghost Town can bypass this encounter. The achievement requires both independently moving engine pieces, not merely surviving the area.

steps.text: Near the end of Episode Three, stop when the two possessed steam-engine components attack in the @loc{Ghost Town}.
Hold the flashlight on each component until both are destroyed, then continue toward the next objective.

achievements.description: Meet the kidnapper.
achievements.summary: During Episode Three, reach the scheduled meeting with the @npc{kidnapper}.

guide.context: This meeting is mandatory story progress and cannot be skipped through an alternate route or dialogue choice.

steps.text: Follow the Episode Three objectives to the scheduled meeting with the @npc{kidnapper}; the achievement unlocks during the story scene.

achievements.description: Listen to Hartman's recordings.
achievements.summary: Early in Episode Four, play all three @npc{Dr. Hartman} recordings in the @loc{Cauldron Lake Lodge staff wing}.

guide.context: The recordings share one tape machine, so the button must be pressed again after each segment finishes.

steps.text: After Alan receives the staff-wing key, enter the @loc{staff wing} and find the small room opposite Dr. Hartman's portrait.
Use the tape recorder on the desk three times, waiting for each recording to finish before starting the next one.

achievements.description: Have a rock'n'roll moment without dropping to a low health state.
achievements.summary: Survive the Episode Four @loc{Anderson Farm stage} battle without Alan reaching his final health bar.

guide.context: The Taken approach from the front-left and front-right rather than spawning behind the stage. Reaching critical health fails the condition, but the checkpoint can be reloaded for another attempt.

steps.text: During the stage battle, watch both sides, burn away each Taken's darkness, and use the supplied weapons to keep enemies off the platform.
Whenever @npc{Barry} activates the stage light, move into its beam to restore health before the last bar is reached.
Finish the entire concert battle above critical health; reload the checkpoint immediately if Alan drops to the final health bar.

achievements.description: Take a moment to reflect on past events.
achievements.summary: Complete Episode Four's mandatory memory sequence until Alan recalls the preceding events.

guide.context: Episode Four also contains the optional Hartman recordings and the later Anderson Farm health challenge, but neither side objective is a prerequisite for this memory unlock.

steps.text: Continue the Episode Four objectives and story scenes until Alan finishes reconstructing what happened at Cauldron Lake.

achievements.description: Put de lime in de coconut twice.
achievements.summary: Use the @loc{Oh Deer Diner} jukebox in both Episode One and Episode Five during the same playthrough.

guide.context: The two uses must belong to one continuous playthrough; chapter select or a checkpoint reload cannot combine jukebox credit from separate runs.

steps.text: In Episode One after leaving the ferry, accept the @npc{Anderson brothers'} request inside the @loc{Oh Deer Diner} and start the jukebox beside them.
In Episode Five after opening the gate to the main road with @npc{Sheriff Breaker}, turn left, enter the diner, and start the same jukebox again.

achievements.description: Cut the power to the transformer yard.
achievements.summary: During Episode Five, use the transformer-yard kill switch to cut the power.

guide.context: This objective is required to advance through the power-plant route, so it cannot be missed.

steps.text: Follow the Episode Five objectives through the @loc{transformer yard} while clearing the Taken and electrical hazards.
Reach the control point and activate the kill switch to shut down the transformer yard.

achievements.description: Discover the secret she guards.
achievements.summary: Follow @npc{Cynthia Weaver} into the @loc{Well-Lit Room} during the late Episode Five story.

guide.context: Cynthia's route is mandatory and has no dialogue or exploration condition that can cancel the unlock.

steps.text: Continue the Episode Five power-plant objectives and stay with @npc{Cynthia Weaver} until she opens the path to the @loc{Well-Lit Room}.
Enter the Well-Lit Room and complete the story scene inside.

achievements.description: Defeat the tornado.
achievements.summary: Complete Episode Six's final @enemy{tornado} confrontation by using the @item{Clicker}.

guide.context: The tornado is the mandatory final obstacle of the base game, and ordinary weapons do not replace the required Clicker interaction.

steps.text: Follow the Episode Six route to the tornado and clear the required path with light.
Reach the final interaction point and use the @item{Clicker} to end the tornado sequence.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Normal difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete all six main-game episodes on @mechanic{Normal difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: Difficulty completions stack, so the later Nightmare playthrough can award Normal without a dedicated Normal run.

steps.text: Finish Episodes One through Six on @mechanic{Normal}, Hard, or Nightmare difficulty and remain through the ending until the completion registers.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete all six main-game episodes on @mechanic{Hard difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: Nightmare completion also satisfies Hard, allowing the recommended two-playthrough route to use Easy first and Nightmare second.

steps.text: Finish Episodes One through Six on @mechanic{Hard} or Nightmare difficulty and complete the ending sequence.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Nightmare difficulty.
achievements.summary: Unlock @mechanic{Nightmare} by finishing the game once, then complete all six episodes on Nightmare.

guide.context: Nightmare reduces available supplies and increases incoming damage. Only its 15 exclusive manuscript pages justify optional detours during this run.

steps.text: Complete the base game on any available difficulty to unlock @mechanic{Nightmare}.
Start a Nightmare run, conserve ammunition, use flares and safe havens to escape avoidable groups, and finish Episodes One through Six.

achievements.description: Burn 1,000 birds.
achievements.summary: Destroy 1,000 birds with the flashlight, flares, or flare gun.

guide.context: Bird kills are cumulative and are saved immediately, so restarting a checkpoint restores supplies without removing recorded kills.

steps.text: For cleanup, load the late Episode Two checkpoint where bird flocks attack @npc{Barry's cabin}.
Destroy every flock with boosted flashlight light, flares, and flare-gun shots.
Restart the checkpoint after the flocks are gone and repeat until the cumulative total reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Inanimate objects shouldn't move of their own accord. Put a stop to this affront, oh, say, 20 times.
achievements.summary: Destroy 20 possessed poltergeist objects with sustained light.

guide.context: Possessed objects begin appearing in Episode Three and do not require gunfire; their destruction count accumulates across the game.

steps.text: When furniture, machinery, or debris becomes possessed and attacks, aim the flashlight directly at the moving object.
Maintain the light beam until the object disintegrates, and repeat for 20 possessed objects.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 Taken with the revolver.
achievements.summary: Kill 100 Taken with the @item{revolver} after removing their darkness shields.

guide.context: The revolver is Alan's most common firearm, and each kill is added to statistics immediately even if the checkpoint is later restarted.

steps.text: Burn away a Taken's darkness shield with the flashlight.
Land the killing shots with the @item{revolver} and continue until 100 Taken have died to that weapon.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 Taken with the hunting rifle.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 Taken with the @item{hunting rifle} after removing their darkness shields.

guide.context: The hunting rifle and its ammunition appear less often than shotguns, so spending rifle rounds on ordinary Taken avoids a long cleanup.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{hunting rifle} and all available rifle ammunition whenever the weapon appears.
Strip Taken darkness shields with light, then use the hunting rifle for 50 killing shots; replay the @loc{Anderson Farm stage} checkpoint if additional targets are needed.

achievements.displayName: It's Not Just a Typewriter Brand
achievements.description: Defeat 50 Taken with a shotgun.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 Taken with either shotgun after removing their darkness shields.

guide.context: Both shotgun variants contribute to the same cumulative counter, and recorded kills survive checkpoint restarts.

steps.text: Remove each Taken's darkness shield and allow the enemy to enter effective shotgun range.
Land 50 killing blasts with the shotgun or pump-action shotgun.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 Taken with the flaregun, the way Shakespeare intended.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 Taken with @item{flare-gun} shots.

guide.context: Flare-gun ammunition is scarce, but cumulative kills persist after restarting a checkpoint and one shot can credit several clustered enemies.

steps.text: At a checkpoint with flare-gun ammunition and several ordinary Taken, remove their darkness and gather them into a tight group.
Fire the @item{flare gun} into the group, then restart the checkpoint to restore ammunition and repeat until 50 Taken are credited.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 Taken with flashbang grenades.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 Taken with @item{flashbang grenades}.

guide.context: Flashbangs first appear in Episode Three and kill ordinary Taken in their blast after the enemies have approached closely enough.

steps.text: Lure several Taken into a compact group near Alan.
Throw a @item{flashbang grenade} into the group and repeat through Episode Three or a reusable checkpoint until 50 Taken are killed.

achievements.description: Defeat 20 Taken with indirect means.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 Taken through environmental hazards or other indirect damage.

guide.context: Eligible kills include explosive canisters, hanging electrical wires, cliff falls, and the automatic fireworks during the Anderson Farm concert.

steps.text: Lead Taken beside red explosive canisters, live wires, cliff edges, or the @loc{Anderson Farm stage} firework zones.
Trigger the hazard with gunfire or boosted flashlight pressure and let the environment deliver the killing damage to 20 Taken.

achievements.description: Kill four Taken with a single shot from the flaregun.
achievements.summary: Kill four Taken with one @item{flare-gun} shot.

guide.context: Large Taken may survive a single shot, so ordinary Taken provide a more reliable four-kill group.

steps.text: At the Episode Four stage defense or another large wave, strip the darkness from at least four ordinary Taken and circle until they cluster.
Fire one @item{flare-gun} round into the center of the group and confirm that all four Taken die from that shot.

achievements.description: Kill four Taken with a single flashbang.
achievements.summary: Kill four Taken with one @item{flashbang grenade}.

guide.context: Episode Three near the radio station and the Episode Four stage defense both offer dense waves plus nearby checkpoints for retries.

steps.text: Back away from at least four ordinary Taken until they close into one group.
Drop a @item{flashbang grenade} in the center of the group and ensure one blast kills four Taken.

achievements.displayName: Two For the Price of One
achievements.description: Kill two Taken with a single shotgun blast.
achievements.summary: Kill two adjacent Taken with one shotgun blast.

guide.context: Shotgun spread loses force over distance, so both enemies must be unshielded and nearly touching Alan and each other.

steps.text: Remove the darkness shields from two ordinary Taken and maneuver until they stand side by side at close range.
Aim across both enemies and fire one shotgun blast that kills the pair.

achievements.description: Save yourself with a flare.
achievements.summary: At critical health, light and hold a flare as a nearby Taken begins a lethal attack.

guide.context: Critical health is signaled by a gray screen and Alan's pounding heartbeat; dropping or throwing the flare does not demonstrate the required defensive hold.

steps.text: Let one nearby Taken damage Alan until the screen turns gray and the heartbeat sound begins.
Equip, light, and hold a @item{flare} as the Taken winds up its next attack, keeping the flare in Alan's hand until the unlock appears.

achievements.description: Perform a cinematic dodge.
achievements.summary: Perform one slow-motion cinematic dodge immediately before a Taken attack connects.

guide.context: An ordinary roll does not count; successful timing causes a close-up slow-motion camera effect.

steps.text: Face an attacking Taken and wait until its weapon swing is about to connect.
Press dodge together with a movement direction at the last moment and confirm the camera enters slow motion.

achievements.description: Perform a cinematic dodge 20 times.
achievements.summary: Perform 20 slow-motion cinematic dodges immediately before Taken attacks connect.

guide.context: Only dodges that trigger the close-up slow-motion effect count toward the cumulative total.

steps.text: Bait Taken melee swings and press dodge plus a movement direction just before each strike reaches Alan.
Repeat until 20 separate dodges trigger the slow-motion camera effect.

achievements.description: Use 100 batteries.
achievements.summary: Manually replace 100 flashlight batteries.

guide.context: Battery use is recorded immediately, so a checkpoint restart restores inventory without erasing replacements already counted.

steps.text: Boost the flashlight until its charge falls, then manually insert a @item{battery}.
Use available batteries at a supply-rich checkpoint, restart to restore them, and continue until 100 replacements are recorded.

achievements.description: Get a generator running.
achievements.summary: Start the first mandatory generator during the opening story route.

guide.context: The generator is required for progression and introduces the timing interaction used by later generators.

steps.text: Approach the first generator, interact with it, and complete the displayed timing inputs until the engine starts.

achievements.description: Knock over five can pyramids.
achievements.estTime: across the story or 10 min cleanup
achievements.summary: Shoot down any five of the 12 red can pyramids across the main game.

guide.context: The game contains seven more pyramids than the achievement requires, so missed early stacks do not force a restart.

steps.text: After the Episode One tutorial's first Taken encounter, look over the nearby fence beside the large rock and shoot the red can pyramid.
Inspect tables, barrels, spools, walls, and vehicle roofs along later episode routes for four more stacked red-can pyramids.
Shoot each stack until it collapses and continue until five different pyramids have registered.

achievements.description: In ''Mirror Peak,'' make it from the Coal Mine Museum to Cauldron Lake in 30 minutes.
achievements.summary: In Episode Three's @loc{Mirror Peak}, reach the @loc{Cauldron Lake lookout} within 30 minutes of the Coal Mine Museum phone call.

guide.context: Checkpoint reloads can repair a slow section. Optional battles, including the possessed steam-engine encounter, consume time and may be bypassed during this attempt.

steps.text: Load @mechanic{Episode Three — Mirror Peak} on Easy and begin moving immediately after the telephone call at the @loc{Coal Mine Museum}.
Sprint between safe havens, dodge Taken, and bypass optional poltergeist and steam-engine fights while following the main route.
Reach the @loc{Cauldron Lake lookout} before 30 minutes have elapsed from the phone call.

achievements.description: Make it through ''Night Life in Bright Falls'' in one go without dying or restarting even once.
achievements.summary: Complete Episode Five's @mechanic{Night Life in Bright Falls} chapter without dying, restarting, or reloading.

guide.context: Any death or manual checkpoint action invalidates that attempt, so Easy difficulty and conserved flare-gun or flashbang ammunition provide the safest route.

steps.text: Load @mechanic{Episode Five — Night Life in Bright Falls} on Easy and begin a fresh chapter attempt.
Move cautiously through every street battle, use powerful supplies on dense groups, and avoid the Pause-menu restart or reload commands.
Reach the end of the chapter in the same uninterrupted life to receive the achievement.

achievements.description: Make it to Cauldron Lake without firing a single shot in ''On the Road to Cauldron Lake.''
achievements.summary: Complete Episode Six's @mechanic{On the Road to Cauldron Lake} without firing a revolver, shotgun, rifle, or flare gun.

guide.context: Flares and flashbangs are permitted because they are not firearms. Reloading the latest clean checkpoint can recover from an accidental shot if no shot was fired before that checkpoint.

steps.text: Load @mechanic{Episode Six — On the Road to Cauldron Lake} on Easy and leave every firearm unfired.
Hold flares to push Taken back, throw flashbangs at unavoidable groups, and sprint between safe havens instead of fighting with guns.
Reach the final Cauldron Lake tornado area without firing any prohibited weapon.

achievements.description: Drive over 15 Taken.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 Taken by running them over with vehicles.

guide.context: Vehicle headlights can remove darkness shields, but only the collision that kills the now-vulnerable Taken adds to the counter.

steps.text: Beginning with the Episode Two vehicle section, aim at Taken and boost the headlights until their darkness shields disappear.
Accelerate into each unshielded Taken and continue across vehicle sections until 15 collision kills are recorded.

achievements.description: Discover 5 hidden chests.
achievements.summary: Follow yellow reflective markings and open five hidden supply chests.

guide.context: Thirty hidden chests exist across the six episodes, so this threshold allows substantial room for missed routes.

steps.text: Sweep the flashlight across walls, rocks, and trees to reveal yellow arrows and dots beside the story path.
Follow each reflective trail to its concealed red supply chest and open five different chests.

achievements.description: Discover all of the hidden chests.
achievements.summary: Open all 30 hidden supply chests across Episodes One through Six.

guide.context: Chest credit is stored immediately in the collectible statistics, allowing omissions to be recovered through chapter select without repeating already opened chests.

steps.text: During each episode, sweep the flashlight over side-path walls, rocks, and trees for yellow reflective arrows and dots.
Follow every marked side route and open the red supply chest at its end before returning to the story path.
Check the episode statistics after each chapter, use chapter select for any incomplete episode, and continue until all 30 chests are recorded.

achievements.description: Find 25 manuscript pages.
achievements.summary: Collect any 25 manuscript pages from the main-game episodes.

guide.context: Pages are recorded as soon as they are picked up and remain counted after deaths or checkpoint restarts.

steps.text: Inspect lit paths, buildings, and short side routes for glowing white @item{manuscript pages}.
Pick up 25 different pages across the six episodes.

achievements.description: Find all of the manuscript pages in Normal mode.
achievements.summary: Collect all 91 manuscript pages available on Normal or Hard across Episodes One through Six.

guide.context: The episode statistics identify where a page is missing, and chapter select can recover omissions without resetting collected-page credit.

steps.text: On Normal or Hard, search the main path and nearby detours in every episode for glowing @item{manuscript pages}.
At each episode boundary, compare the manuscript statistic with the completed route and replay any incomplete chapter through chapter select.
Collect the final lower-difficulty page so the total reaches 91.

achievements.description: Find all of the manuscript pages in the game, including the ones in Nightmare mode.
achievements.summary: Collect all 106 manuscript pages, including the 15 pages found only on Nightmare difficulty.

guide.context: Nightmare unlocks only after one completed playthrough. Its exclusive pages supplement the 91 lower-difficulty pages rather than replacing them.

steps.text: Collect all 91 manuscript pages available on Normal or Hard and verify those episode totals.
Finish the game once, start @mechanic{Nightmare}, and inspect the additional lit detours for the 15 Nightmare-only pages.
Pick up every exclusive page during the Nightmare run until the manuscript total reaches 106.

achievements.description: Discover 25 coffee thermoses.
achievements.summary: Collect any 25 coffee thermoses from the six main-game episodes.

guide.context: Thermos credit is stored immediately and persists after checkpoint restarts.

steps.text: Inspect counters, tables, railings, rocks, and short side paths for blue @item{coffee thermoses}.
Pick up 25 different thermoses across Episodes One through Six.

achievements.description: Discover all coffee thermoses.
achievements.summary: Collect all 100 coffee thermoses across Episodes One through Six.

guide.context: Collected thermoses remain recorded across chapter select, and the episode statistics narrow cleanup to the chapter containing an omission.

steps.text: Search buildings, roadside structures, overlooks, and short detours during every episode for blue @item{coffee thermoses}.
Review the collectible statistics at episode boundaries and replay only chapters whose thermos total is incomplete.
Collect every missing thermos until the global total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Listen to all of the radio shows.
achievements.summary: Activate and listen to all 11 radio broadcasts across Episodes One through Four.

guide.context: Ten broadcasts come from physical radios; the Episode Three broadcast at the radio station begins automatically and still counts.

steps.text: Activate each radio found in cabins, stations, trailers, ruins, and the Anderson Farm silo, then remain nearby until its broadcast registers.
During Episode Three, stay for @npc{Pat Maine's} automatic broadcast at the @loc{radio station}.
Use episode statistics and chapter select to recover any omitted broadcast until all 11 are counted.

achievements.description: Watch every single TV show.
achievements.summary: Watch all 14 counted television programs across Episodes One through Five.

guide.context: Some Writer in the Cabin programs start automatically, while Night Springs sets require activation. The Episode Four advertising set used for Boob Tube is excluded from this total.

steps.text: Turn on each manual television in offices, cabins, the diner route, Town Hall, and bridge-control rooms, then remain until the program registers.
When an automatically starting Writer in the Cabin set activates, stay in the room until its entry is added to statistics.
Check episode statistics and replay incomplete chapters until all 14 counted programs have been watched.

achievements.description: Absorb every bit of local history and culture.
achievements.summary: Read all 25 Bright Falls history and culture signs or points of interest.

guide.context: A sign only counts after Alan stands close enough to use its read prompt; merely passing or shining the flashlight on it is insufficient.

steps.text: Inspect visitor-center displays, town signs, plaques, flyers, and other marked points of interest along Episodes One through Six.
Stand at each display and use the read prompt until its entry registers in the statistics.
Use episode statistics and chapter select to revisit incomplete chapters until all 25 entries are recorded.

achievements.description: Special 1: Find someone to help you.
achievements.summary: Start @mechanic{The Signal} and follow the story until Alan reaches @npc{Barry}.

guide.context: The Signal is selected from the Episodes menu, and this first DLC milestone is automatic.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Episodes — The Signal}, begin the episode, and follow its required objectives.
Continue until Alan reaches @npc{Barry} and the story scene awards the achievement.

achievements.description: Special 1: Follow the signal to its conclusion.
achievements.summary: Follow the signal through the entire @mechanic{The Signal} episode and complete its ending.

guide.context: This achievement is the automatic episode completion; the optional clocks, standees, furnaces, vehicles, and timer do not block it.

steps.text: Complete every required objective in @mechanic{The Signal} and defeat the final television encounter.
Continue through the concluding scene until the episode completion registers.

achievements.description: Special 1: Make it through the final battle in less than 1 minute and 30 seconds.
achievements.estTime: under 2 min at The Signal finale
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{The Signal's} final television battle within 1 minute 30 seconds.

guide.context: The timer covers the final battle rather than the whole episode. Enter with flare-gun ammunition and flares so every target can be destroyed without conventional shield stripping.

steps.text: Inside the apartment, light a @item{flare} to force the television through the wall, drop after it, and immediately fire the @item{flare gun} into the television cluster.
Move outside until the boat crashes onto the dock, then drop another flare and fire the flare gun into the remaining darkness.
Destroy the final target before 1 minute 30 seconds elapse from the battle start.

achievements.description: Special 1: Trigger all of the furnaces in the basement.
achievements.summary: In @mechanic{The Signal's} basement, illuminate every furnace marked @mechanic{Blast}.

guide.context: All furnaces must be triggered during the same basement visit because the route moves beyond the area afterward.

steps.text: Before leaving the basement, sweep every room for the glowing @mechanic{Blast} words attached to furnaces.
Focus the flashlight on each Blast word until its furnace erupts; the achievement unlocks when the final furnace is activated.

achievements.description: Special 1: Complete the episode without reloading the game or restarting a checkpoint.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Signal} from beginning to ending without dying, continuing, reloading, or restarting a checkpoint.

guide.context: Any checkpoint manipulation invalidates the run, even if the loaded checkpoint predates the mistake. A failure requires starting The Signal again from its beginning.

steps.text: Start a fresh @mechanic{The Signal} episode on Normal and avoid the Continue, Reload, and Restart Checkpoint commands.
Use held flares to create space, reserve flare-gun ammunition for dangerous waves, and run to safe havens whenever combat can be bypassed.
Complete the final encounter and ending in the same uninterrupted life.

achievements.description: Special 1: Complete the episode without using a single vehicle.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Signal} without entering or creating a vehicle.

guide.context: The sawmill's Wheels words spawn Jeeps when illuminated; avoiding those words keeps the required on-foot route available.

steps.text: At the large sawmill area, keep the flashlight away from every glowing @mechanic{Wheels} word and do not enter any Jeep.
Dodge the Taken and monster trucks on foot, open the warehouse, clear the interior, and exit upstairs.
Drop outside over the parked car and continue to the episode ending without using a vehicle.

achievements.description: Special 1: Discover 10 hidden alarm clocks.
achievements.summary: Collect all 10 ticking alarm clocks in @mechanic{The Signal}.

guide.context: The episode contains no chapter-level free roam, and several route transitions prevent backtracking. Listen for ticking and collect each clock before advancing.

steps.text: After obtaining the flashlight and gun at the @loc{Oh Deer Diner}, defeat the large Taken from the kitchen and collect alarm clock 1 beside the sink.
After passing through the @loc{playground} gate, jump over the fallen trees and collect alarm clock 2 from the bench beneath them.
At the basement stairs marked @mechanic{Climb}, turn to the opposite side and collect alarm clock 3 from the chair.
After the television explains invisible Taken, continue through the woods to the sign and overturned train cart, then collect alarm clock 4 from the cart's edge.
Before the sawmill, illuminate the @mechanic{Turret} word, use the resulting floodlight to open the space beneath the circus tent, and collect alarm clock 5 from the box inside.
Descend the streetlight hillside until a gap in the rocks reveals a fence overlooking the final lights, then collect alarm clock 6 from the rock behind the fence.
From the open sawmill entrance with the @mechanic{Red Box} and @mechanic{Wheels} words, walk straight and collect alarm clock 7 from the lumber pile beside the lumber-filled building.
Beneath the dock, illuminate the @mechanic{Climb} word, climb up, turn around, and collect alarm clock 8 at the far end of the pier.
After defeating the chainsaw Taken, approach the log cabin and collect alarm clock 9 against the fence on the cabin's left side.
Inside @loc{Alan's apartment}, enter the office and collect alarm clock 10 from the lounge chair beside the lamp.

achievements.description: Special 1: Discover all of the cardboard standees.
achievements.summary: Find and read all six character standees in @mechanic{The Signal}.

guide.context: Each standee represents a different Bright Falls character, and the interaction must be completed so its biography registers before Alan moves on.

steps.text: After leaving the tool store, turn right around the building and read the @npc{Otis Anderson} standee beside the street fence.
After vaulting the fence and viewing the missing street, keep left among the flashlight words and read the @npc{Sheriff Sarah Breaker} standee.
After defeating the deer float and truck and opening the church, enter and read the @npc{Barry Wheeler} standee on the left behind the pews near a window.
After the floodlight illuminates the moving Bridge words and three train carts fall, drop through the first cart and read the @npc{Cynthia Weaver} standee on the small cliff to the right.
After the long streetlight area, stop before entering the sawmill and read the @npc{Tor Anderson} standee behind a tree to the right of the overturned crane.
After jumping from the warehouse near the Memory and Bridge words, approach the truck beside the large crane, turn right, and read the @npc{Alice Wake} standee by the woodpile behind the truck.

achievements.description: Special 2: Complete the elevator ride.
achievements.summary: In @mechanic{The Writer}, traverse the rotating interior and ride the mandatory elevator.

guide.context: The rotating rooms can loop back to earlier doors; the correct exit is marked by a light above it and a yellow arrow beyond it.

steps.text: Move through each rotating room when gravity aligns a doorway, using the lit doorway and yellow floor arrow to avoid backtracking.
Wait for the armored door to rotate open, continue through it, and enter the elevator; the achievement unlocks during the ride.

achievements.description: Special 2: Defeat the final obstacle between you and your goal.
achievements.summary: Defeat all five boss waves in @mechanic{The Writer's} final encounter outside the cabin.

guide.context: The arena supplies unlimited revolver rounds, shotgun shells, and batteries. Flares suppress the accompanying birds and keep the fast Taken from reaching Alan.

steps.text: Keep a lit @item{flare} near Alan, use boosted light to strip each fast Taken's darkness, and ignore the harmless darkness pools near the cabin.
Defeat the first single boss, the pair in wave two, and the final three single bosses while controlling their bird swarms.
Eliminate the fifth boss to end the mandatory encounter.

achievements.displayName: Go Gentle Into That Good Light
achievements.description: Special 2: Make it through the approach to the lighthouse without firing a weapon.
achievements.summary: In @mechanic{The Writer}, reach the second lighthouse safe haven after the Memory and Ignite words without firing a gun.

guide.context: Held flares and flashbangs are permitted, and an automatic light destroys exposed Taken. Reloading a clean checkpoint can recover from an accidental shot.

steps.text: After collecting the manuscript that creates @mechanic{Memory} and @mechanic{Ignite}, leave every firearm unfired.
Hold flares to repel Taken, illuminate the @mechanic{Clear} words to remove rock barriers, and let the automatic light kill pursuing enemies.
Reach the second safe haven at the top of the lighthouse approach and walk a few steps beyond it without firing a gun.

achievements.description: Special 2: Complete the episode without reloading the game or restarting a checkpoint.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Writer} from beginning to ending without dying, continuing, reloading, or restarting a checkpoint.

guide.context: Any checkpoint manipulation invalidates the attempt, so a failure requires restarting The Writer from its opening rather than resuming the current run.

steps.text: Begin a fresh @mechanic{The Writer} episode on Normal and avoid Continue, Reload, and Restart Checkpoint.
Use every Fireworks word to build a large flare reserve, then spend flares whenever a death risk is higher than the cost.
Survive the tornado route, lighthouse approach, final bosses, and cabin ending in one uninterrupted life.

achievements.description: Special 2: Survive the final encounter without being seriously hurt.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Writer's} final five-wave encounter without reaching critical health.

guide.context: Critical health is indicated by a black-and-white screen. Reloading the current checkpoint is allowed if Alan had not reached critical health before that checkpoint was created.

steps.text: Carry roughly ten @item{flares} into the final arena and collect ammunition and batteries from the unlimited supplies.
Keep a flare burning for protection, use boosted light continuously on each boss, and finish the five waves without the screen turning black and white.
If critical health occurs, reload the latest clean checkpoint and repeat the affected waves.

achievements.description: Special 2: Make your way past the tornado in under 60 seconds.
achievements.summary: Cross @mechanic{The Writer's} tornado platforming section and climb its exit ladder within 60 seconds.

guide.context: The timer can be retried from the checkpoint created on the middle platform, although that restart cannot be used during a simultaneous No Punctuation run.

steps.text: After the television collapses the thin platform, illuminate the first rideable Bridge object, ride it across, and create the @mechanic{Path} landing.
At the middle checkpoint, stun the Taken on the left with boosted light, avoid the damaging Tools word, and illuminate the second bridge and landing.
Cross the final objects and climb the ladder before 60 seconds have elapsed.

achievements.description: Special 2: Discover 10 Night Springs video games.
achievements.summary: Collect all 10 Night Springs video-game boxes in @mechanic{The Writer}.

guide.context: Several locations lie behind moving geometry or no-return transitions. Collect each box immediately and verify the total before advancing toward the final cabin.

steps.text: After climbing into the opening hedge maze, take the left branch at the first fork and follow it to Night Springs video game 1.
Inside the cabin after the first assault, face away from @npc{Barry} and collect video game 2 to the left of the fireplace.
Leave the cabin through its rear door, descend the stairs straight ahead, and collect video game 3 on the left at the corner.

After the boat ride, enter and leave the created cabin to start its rotation, jump onto the protruding attic edge, and climb onto the roof to collect video game 4 when the roof rotates level with the platform.
After the elevator ride, run right past the DeerFest cart and collect video game 5 off the left side of the road near its broken section.
At the street bridge after the log lift, vault a log on the crashed truck to the right and collect video game 6 behind the truck.
After using the fallen tree to return to ground level, keep to the far-left path and collect video game 7 behind and right of the large rusted object.
At the crashed airplane, drop through the wing opening, enter from the rear, and collect video game 8 inside before taking the nearby cave detour.
Before entering the lighthouse, circle behind the building and collect video game 9 from the red chair.
After the lighthouse cutscene leaves Alan facing the Divers Isle bridge, turn around, run to the top of the hill, and collect video game 10 from the stump on the left.

achievements.description: Special 2: Discover the secret area.
achievements.summary: In @mechanic{The Writer}, enter the secret mountain cave beside the crashed airplane.

guide.context: The detour is available immediately after the eighth video-game pickup and becomes unavailable after advancing toward the lighthouse.

steps.text: After entering the crashed airplane for video game 8, leave through its open rear and face that opening.
Move right and then southeast along the mountain wall until a narrow passage appears on the right.
Walk through the passage into the secret cave to trigger the achievement.

achievements.description: Special 2: Have some poison poured in your ear.
achievements.summary: In @mechanic{The Writer}, hear Hartman's full conversation, tape recording, and follow-up before leaving the dark room.

guide.context: Leaving before the lights return permanently skips the trigger for that run, even if the tape recorder itself was activated.

steps.text: Remain in the dark conversation room until @npc{Dr. Hartman} finishes speaking and a light highlights the tape recorder.
Activate the recorder and stay through the entire tape and the conversation that follows.
Wait until the room lights turn back on, then leave through the door and continue until Alan's next spoken line triggers the achievement.
